entities.summary: Adrian Jarrell Clayborn is an American former professional football player who was a defensive end in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the University of Iowa, and earned consensus All-American honors. He was selected by the Tampa Bay Buccaneers in the first round of the 2011 NFL draft. Clayborn also played for the Atlanta Falcons, Cleveland Browns and New England Patriots. With the Patriots, he won Super Bowl LIII over the Los Angeles Rams. Clayborn is one of 6 NFL players to record 6 sacks in a game, doing so as a member of the Falcons in 2017.
